author: reek
body: bp-fetch pins every frame it hands back and bp-find-victim refuses to evict a pinned frame, so the two fetched pages must be unpinned before the third fetch or the pool correctly declines to admit it and no eviction happens at all. Without the unpins this test exercised the refusal path while claiming to test LRU.

target: section:Tests 49 to 52 -- What db-test held and this suite did not
author: reek
body: Folded in when the two suites were deduplicated. db-test's other eight assertions were already here in stronger form; these five were not: a NULL column threaded through insert, query and render; the catalog-table-row-count accessor; the global aggregate with an empty group-by list; a heap delete visible through a following query; and a table drop with an exists-after check.
